richiami.difetto: Damage to the tyre structure could have occurred during the mounting of the tyre to the wheel. This can lead to severe tyre sidewall deformation and rapid deflation.
richiami.modello: PNEUMATIC TYRE (TRAILER WHEEL & TYRE) , PNEUMATIC TYRE (TRAILER WHEEL & TYRE)
richiami.rimedio: Recall the units in the UK that are likely to be affected and the wheel and tyre assembly will be changed.
richiami.titolo: TYRE MAY RAPIDLY DEFLATE WITHOUT WARNING
